title: 序章17 回矿坑序章18 变况
content_zh:
虽然听这么一大段故事不是黎木的本意，但他最终还是没能打断对面的女子。
他原本以为对方是一个麻木寡言的人，却又不曾想对方如此擅言。
由此，黎木也明白了。
并不是单单异族不受待见。
而是，马尔提雅的一切就像是旧社会的劣化版，不光吃人，连骨头渣滓也不会吐。
“你想要知道些什么？”
面前的女子开口道，打断了黎木的思绪。
黎木再看向面前这位年轻却色衰的女子，沉默了许久才开口道：“给我讲讲这项圈，以及矿区里的一些规律吧...”
女子似乎是站久了，又因为后背和后股有伤，无法坐下和背靠的她，以一种奇怪的姿势侧靠墙壁，就那么缓缓说了起来。
首先便是项圈。
跟黎木猜的没多大区别。
这项圈能够与灵魂纠缠，除非在灵魂层面受到重大打击，将其纠缠“粉碎”
或“挤出”
，否则自己硬扯开必然会受到反噬。
并且，项圈能够受到咒语共振激发，只要有魔法天赋，无论谁念都可以，直接晕眩携带者，灵魂强度不够的甚至会被撕裂灵魂，直接成为白痴。
而关于灵魂层面的技术，就连马文都无法涉足一二。
马尔提雅之所以掌握着这种项圈，就是因为他们曾经还在巨兽背上的时候，被魔法堡抓过去奴役研究过。
技术就是那时候偷来的。
不过因为学不会其中原理，只能依葫芦画瓢，弄了个半成品，就成了现在的项圈。
另一个问题。

整个矿区也并非表面国有，私下贪腐那么简单。
矿区因为地处边境之地，其中混杂着大量的势力。
可以说，整个矿区，大大小小三百多个矿坑里，每一个工头都不是简单的犯人。
他们每一个人的背后，都有一条或几条利益链。
矿石的重要性与定期送来奴隶的可操作性，以及马尔提雅落后的集权制度下，让这么一个偏僻之地，成为了最好的“地下捞金”
之地。
各个矿坑之间甚至存在竞争关系。
工头就是棋子，他们背后的贵族、势力则是弈手。
甚至传言，这里还有皇家的人。
怎么弄死你家工头，怎么安插自家工头，怎么调整利益策略...换言之，这里根本就算不上什么“国有”
“对了，还有一件事，你既然从黑蔷薇监狱来的，那应该知道音乐会吧？”
说到这里，女子又问道。
“当然。”
黎木默默的说道。
content_en:
Although listening to such a long story was not Li Mu's original intention, he ultimately failed to interrupt the woman opposite.
He originally thought that the other party was an insensitive and taciturn person, but he never thought that the other party was so good at talking.
From this, Li Mu also understood.
It's not just foreigners who are unpopular.
Instead, everything in Martiya is like a degraded version of the old society. Not only does it eat people, but it doesn't even spit out bones and dregs.
"What do you want to know?"
The woman in front of him spoke, interrupting Li Mu's thoughts.
Li Mu looked at the young but faded woman in front of him again. After a long silence, he said, "Tell me about this collar and some of the rules in the mining area..."
The woman seemed to have been standing for a long time, and because of injuries to her back and hips, she was unable to sit down or lean against the wall. She leaned against the wall in a strange posture and spoke slowly.
The first is the collar.
It's not much different from what Li Mu guessed.
This circle can be entangled with the soul unless it suffers a major blow at the soul level to "shatter" its entanglement.
or "extrude"
, otherwise you will inevitably suffer backlash if you forcefully tear it away.
Moreover, the collar can be stimulated by the resonance of spells. As long as there is magic talent, no matter who reads it, it can directly stun the wearer. If the soul strength is not enough, the soul will be torn apart and the wearer will become an idiot directly.
As for soul-level technology, not even Marvin can get involved.
The reason why Martia has this kind of collar is because when they were still on the back of the giant beast, they were captured by the Magic Castle and enslaved for study.
The technology was stolen at that time.
However, because I couldn't learn the principles, I could only follow the example and made a semi-finished product, which became the current collar.
Another question.
The entire mining area is not just state-owned on the surface, but simply corrupted privately.
Because the mining area is located on the border, there are a lot of forces mixed in it.
It can be said that in the entire mining area, every foreman in the more than 300 mines, large and small, is not a simple prisoner.
Behind each of them, there is one or several chains of interests.
The importance of the ore and the operability of regularly sending slaves, as well as the backward centralized system of Martiya, make such a remote place the best "underground gold fishing"
land.
There is even competition between various mines.
The foremen are the chess pieces, and the nobles and forces behind them are the players.
There are even rumors that there are royal people here.
How to kill your foreman, how to install your own foreman, how to adjust the profit strategy... In other words, this place is not considered "state-owned" at all.
"By the way, one more thing. Since you came from Black Rose Prison, you should know about the concert, right?"
Having said this, the woman asked again.
"Of course."
Li Mu said silently.
